critical_governance: No production release may bypass required security, testing, tenant-isolation, rollback/recovery and approval gates.
Artifacts, configuration, schemas and infrastructure are versioned and promoted through controlled environments.
Phase 00-20 requirements must be traceable to tests, implementation surfaces and approved exceptions before enterprise lock.
Production readiness requires operational ownership, observability, SLOs, incident response, backup/restore and DR evidence.
AI/ML assets require versioning, evaluation, guardrails, monitoring, human governance and rollback.
SaaS tenant provisioning supports configurable plans, entitlements, branding/white-label profiles and strict tenant isolation.
